description: React component for user signup page, handling email/password registration and Google OAuth, with form validation, error handling, and navigation upon success.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the signup form inputs, setting error messages for invalid fields.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles input change events, updating form state and clearing errors.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, performs signup via password, manages navigation and error display.

methods.name: onGoogle
methods.description: Handles Google OAuth signup flow, with success and error handling.
